purpose: Evaluate only the completed functional checkpoint selection on the existing 438 frozen acceptance cases.
verified_offline: All eight predetermined validation candidates must complete before selection is recomputed from measured events.
Edited selection records or validation predictions are rejected.
Baseline-only selection and incomplete comparison cannot advance to another acceptance run.
Original provider, dataset, evaluator and driver checks remain in use.
Changing the selected candidate blocks server control before contact.
limitations: Server launch and end-to-end runner execution await complete training and functional comparison.
Offline fixture results verify handoff checks, not model accuracy.
The original active training and scheduled evaluation controls remain unchanged.
Performance and native security verification remain separate from model acceptance.
